author: Bobby Grayson
title: infer_types/1 synthesises the missing @type declarations before collect_types runs: message unions from handle_* clause patterns (tag + arity + callback kind) and sent literals, the reply union from every {:reply, r, _} when all are literal atoms/tagged tuples (else Term), the state from the init/1 literal (%{k: ..} -> a record type). Fields of inferred shapes are term(), which lean_type renders as the new opaque Term. Records become St constructors with NAMED fields; :ets.new is a fresh Term from a hidden ets counter; :ets.delete and resource-only try/rescue are stripped before translation; non-callback public defs are ignored
